All 6 tests pass (the `checksum` dead-code warning is pre-existing, unrelated to this change).

Changed `src/store.rs` from LRU to FIFO eviction: entries now track `written` (set once, at insert time) instead of `used` (touched on every read/write). Eviction picks the entry with the smallest `written` value; `get` no longer mutates state, and rewriting an existing key updates its value in place without touching `written`. Added two tests in `tests/store.rs` covering the new rule: a recently-read entry still gets evicted, and rewriting a key doesn't move it in write order.
